messages:
Ava: quick sync — sketched a 'partner track' selection playbook for a small closed-track release (6–8 partners). Need input on recruitment criteria, feedback cadence, and concrete success metrics. Initial criteria: usage profile (batch vs realtime), security/regulatory fit, integration effort, willingness to commit eng time. Thoughts?

Sam: +1. Also add model/latency sensitivity — e.g., target tokens/sec and p95 latency budgets. Flag teams that can surface HW/infra traces (useful for kernel tuning).

Leah: add a CS gate: must have an assigned CSM and exec sponsor. We can't support partners without an owner for onboarding and weekly syncs.

Marco: can we standardize a 30/60/90 success matrix per partner? I'll draft a template with 'must-have' milestones vs 'stretch' asks. Also propose fortnightly design check-ins.

Ravi: telemetry note — define an eval prompt-set + pass/fail thresholds (hallucination rate, factuality, latency regressions). Recommend capturing per-prompt deltas and a small labeled ground-truth set.

Ava: timeline idea: recruit over next 2 weeks, onboard first 3 in month 1, expand after initial learnings. Volunteers for outreach and docs?

Sam: I can take outreach to infra/ops-focused startups. Draft outreach blurb below:

```
Hi <name>,
We're running a closed partner track to validate low-latency routing and dedicated capacity. Looking for teams doing >200 qps or with p95 <200ms who can provide short infra traces and engage in weekly check-ins. Interested? -Ava + Sam
```

Leah: also scoping success metrics on my end: time-to-first-response (onboarding days), 90-day retention/usage, and measurable cost/token delta pre/post optimizations.

Marco: request: shared Notion + permission to ship sanitized logs for UX & error triage. Will include sample invite in the template.

deploy-bot: Reminder: coordinate any partner-facing canary deploys in #release-war-room and ping @eng-oncall before 1st rollout :bell: 

Ravi: question — will partners be allowed to send PII or sensitive data during the pilot? we need clear DPA/KMS guidance.

Ava: Good catch. We'll require DPA signoff and have an opt-in tokenization step for partners that can't remove PII. Leah, can you lead legal intake?

Leah: Confirmed — legal has a DPA template we can use. See internal link: https://redwood-internal/docs/dpa-template (will copy to the partner Notion).

Sam: one recruiting incentive thought: offer a time-limited reduced-cost Dedicated pilot (3 months credit) to lower friction for ops-heavy partners.

Ava: sounds reasonable. Concrete action items: Sam — outreach to infra startups; Marco — 30/60/90 template + invite copy; Ravi — telemetry suite + prompt set; Leah — legal/DPA + onboarding checklist; Ava — coordinate invites, set up partner Slack channel and Notion. Sync Friday 10am to walk through drafts. :thumbsup: :rocket:
